description: Sends a real email from a connected email account. SIDE EFFECT: the email is sent immediately and cannot be recalled. Requires to, subject, body and either threadId (a reply; takes precedence over connectedAccountId, and a draft-only conversation sends its draft) or connectedAccountId (a new email; an account whose status is ok). to takes {identifier} objects; cc and bcc take email strings. At least one recipient is required across these groups; to: [] allows a Cc-only or Bcc-only email, and Bcc recipients are not shown in To or Cc. A saved draft is sent by passing draftMessageId and draftRevision, as returned when the draft was saved or shown in a thread's messages; each revision is sent at most once and a repeated send returns the first result with repeated true. A saved draft sends with its own files; fileIds attaches CRM files to a new email. A refused draft (changed, recipients differ, still sending, outcome unknown, or another version already sent) was not sent. The enabled account signature and appearance are applied automatically, and the signature is appended in addition to anything written in body. Duplicate reply bodies within a minute are rejected.

bodyFormat.description: How to interpret body. Account appearance is applied to plain text and Markdown; explicit HTML remains caller-controlled. Omit for backwards-compatible automatic detection

draftMessageId.description: Id of the saved draft to send. Each draft revision is sent at most once; a repeated send returns the first result

draftRevision.description: Opaque revision returned with the saved draft; required whenever draftMessageId is provided

fileIds.description: Files to attach from the CRM file store: a file value, a record's files list or an upload without recordId. When sending a saved draft, omitting it sends the draft's own files

to.description: Primary recipients. Use [] for Cc-only or Bcc-only email

workspace.description: Slug or id of the workspace to work in. Optional when the account has exactly one usable workspace; required when it has several. An API key always works in its own workspace.

name: send_email
title: Send email
